creative_intent.logline: A rural Ethiopian mother waits outside her home each afternoon for her daughter to return from school, revealing the quiet depth of a mother's love.
creative_intent.core_message: A mother's love is sometimes found in the simplest things: waiting for her child to come home.

continuity_guide.mother: Fictional adult Ethiopian mother; consistent face, hairstyle, age, and traditional clothing across all shots.
continuity_guide.daughter: Fictional young Ethiopian schoolgirl; consistent face, age, school clothing, and schoolbag across all shots.
continuity_guide.environment: One rural Ethiopian home and one village road; keep spatial layout consistent.
continuity_guide.lighting: Natural warm late-afternoon light, with gradual continuity across the film.
continuity_guide.style: Realistic cinematic photography, restrained performances, natural expressions, no caricature or poverty stereotypes.

shots.title: The village
shots.visual_description: A peaceful rural Ethiopian village in late afternoon. Establish the traditional home and the road outside it. The environment feels lived-in, dignified, and welcoming.
shots.camera: Wide establishing shot; very slow gentle push-in.

audio.speaker: narrator
audio.amharic: በአንድ የገጠር መንደር፣ በየቀኑ ከሰዓት በኋላ አንዲት እናት ከቤቷ ውጭ ትቆማለች።
audio.english_subtitle: In a rural village, every afternoon, a mother stands outside her home.

shots.continuity: Introduce the single village home and the road; preserve their geography in later shots.

shots.title: The mother waits
shots.visual_description: The same mother stands outside her home, looking down the village road. Her posture is patient and familiar, not distressed.
shots.camera: Medium-wide shot at eye level; subtle natural movement.

audio.speaker: narrator
audio.english_subtitle: She waits for her daughter to return from school.

shots.continuity: Use the approved mother character reference, same clothing, hairstyle, home, and afternoon lighting.

shots.title: Time passes
shots.visual_description: The quiet road stretches into the distance. The mother remains near the home, still watching for her daughter.
shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder view from behind the mother toward the road.

audio.speaker: narrator
audio.english_subtitle: Time passes. The road grows quiet.

shots.continuity: Keep the mother in the same position relative to the doorway and road.

shots.title: Still watching
shots.visual_description: A closer view of the mother's thoughtful face as she looks down the road, waiting with hope.
shots.camera: Gentle close-up; natural expression, no exaggerated sadness.

audio.speaker: narrator
audio.amharic: እሷ ግን ዓይኗን ከመንገዱ ላይ አታነሳም። ልጇን በሩቅ እስክታያት ድረስ በተስፋ ትጠብቃለች።
audio.english_subtitle: But she never takes her eyes off the road. She waits with hope until she can see her daughter in the distance.

shots.continuity: Mother's face, clothing, and lighting must match S02.

shots.title: A daughter appears
shots.visual_description: A young Ethiopian schoolgirl appears far down the same road, walking toward the home with a schoolbag over her shoulder.
shots.camera: Long shot down the road; slow, restrained forward movement.

audio.speaker: narrator
audio.amharic: ከሩቅ አንዲት ትንሽ ልጅ በትከሻዋ ላይ ቦርሳ ይዛ ትታያለች።
audio.english_subtitle: Far away, a young girl appears, carrying a schoolbag over her shoulder.

shots.continuity: Use the approved daughter reference and maintain the same road direction and schoolbag.

shots.title: The mother's smile
shots.visual_description: The mother recognizes her daughter in the distance. Her expression naturally brightens into a warm smile.
shots.camera: Medium close-up; slight push-in on the mother's expression.

audio.speaker: narrator
audio.amharic: እናቷም ልጇን ስታውቅ ፊቷ በፈገግታ ይሞላል።
audio.english_subtitle: When the mother recognizes her daughter, her face fills with a smile.

shots.continuity: Keep the mother's appearance and background consistent with earlier shots.

shots.title: The reunion
shots.visual_description: The daughter reaches her mother outside the home. They greet one another warmly; the daughter still has her schoolbag.
shots.camera: Medium two-shot at eye level; gentle, believable movement.
shots.continuity: Both characters must match their approved reference images. Keep the reunion gentle and natural.

shots.title: The question
shots.visual_description: The daughter looks up at her mother with sincere curiosity and asks why her mother waits outside every day.
shots.camera: Close-up of daughter, then optional reaction cut to mother.

audio.speaker: daughter
audio.amharic: እማዬ፣ ለምንድነው በየቀኑ ከቤት ውጭ የምትጠብቂኝ?
audio.english_subtitle: Mother, why do you wait for me outside every day?

shots.continuity: Daughter's face, age, school uniform, and bag must remain consistent.

shots.title: The answer
shots.visual_description: The mother looks at her daughter with affection and answers gently. The emotion is conveyed through her eyes and restrained smile.
shots.camera: Close-up of mother; hold long enough for the answer to land.

audio.speaker: mother
audio.amharic: ልጄ፣ የትም ብትሄጂ፣ ወደ ቤት ስትመለሺ በፍቅር የሚቀበልሽ ሰው እንዳለ እንድታውቂ ነው።
audio.english_subtitle: My daughter, wherever you go, I want you to know that someone will welcome you home with love.

shots.continuity: Mother's appearance must match S02, S04, and S06. Avoid exaggerated lip movement if dialogue is added in post.

shots.title: Walking home
shots.visual_description: The mother and daughter hold hands and walk toward their home in warm late-afternoon light. End on a gentle, reflective image and fade out.
shots.camera: Rear wide shot; slow pull-back or locked-off composition.

audio.speaker: narrator
audio.amharic: አንዳንድ ጊዜ ፍቅር በትልልቅ ቃላት አይገለጽም። በመጠበቅ፣ በመንከባከብና በፈገግታ ይገለጻል። እናት የምትሰጠው ፍቅር እንዲህ ያለ ነው።
audio.english_subtitle: Sometimes love is not expressed through big words. It is expressed through waiting, caring, and smiling. This is the kind of love a mother gives.

shots.continuity: Both characters retain their references and clothing. End card is added during final assembly, not generated inside the shot.
